title: refactor: unify terraform private state layout for gpu node pools, iam, and networking
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Refactor Terraform state layout and module boundaries for Private deployments to unify GPU node pool, IAM, and networking resources into a predictable layout; motivation: previous ad-hoc state splitting caused cross-account drift and made upgrades/rollbacks brittle especially for on-prem and VPC-based installs; this change introduces a canonical modules/ layout, migration helpers that perform 'terraform state mv' operations for affected resources, clear per-environment state prefixes, and backwards-compatible module interfaces so existing stacks can be migrated with minimal downtime; includes automated state-migration plan generation, updated examples, and a rollback path that recreates prior state mappings in case of failure; tested with full terraform plan/apply in a staging VPC (gpu-qa), unit tests for module inputs, and an integration canary that provisions a small GPU node pool and verifies IAM bindings and CNI networking; see linked Linear ENG-4123 for rollout schedule and SUP-8912 for customer impact notes.
commits: feat(modules): introduce modules/gpu_node_pool with parameterized instance_group and tainting support
refactor(state): add state prefixing helpers and migration plan generator script scripts/terraform_state_migrate.sh
feat(iam): split iam module into modules/iam/roles and modules/iam/policies and expose role mapping map variable
chore(examples): update private example to new layout and add migration steps to README
test(ci): add terratest and plan assertions for module inputs
review_comments: [Diego Morales] Can we keep the old state key format available as a fallback? please add an automated detection step in the migration script
[Aisha Kumar] Added detection and fallback flag --dry-run and --rollback mapping. The script will not apply any state moves without explicit --apply flag
[Linnea Chen] IAM policy changes look good; suggest adding an integration check that verifies node identity propagation to KMS for customer-owned keys
[Aisha Kumar] Added KMS propagation check in the terratest integration and documented the requirement in examples/private/README.md
[Marcus Lee] CI plan showed a drift warning on vpc.private_subnets; please confirm change will not affect existing routes
[Aisha Kumar] Confirmed routes unchanged; drift came from module boundary rename only. Added comment to vpc.tf and expanded plan assertion to ensure routes remain present
ci_checks: ci/security-scan: warn - policy uses broader role scoped to node pools (documented)
release_notes: Unify private deployment Terraform state layout across GPU node pools, IAM, and networking; add migration tooling and examples. Migration required for affected private stacks; follow scripts/terraform_state_migrate.sh and examples/private/README.md.
migration_instructions: Run scripts/terraform_state_migrate.sh --dry-run against your staging state; review generated plan, then run --apply during a maintenance window; ensure CI terratest passes; rollback with --rollback mapping if needed.
manual_verification: Provision a small gpu-qa cluster using the new modules and verify: node pool size, GPU pod scheduling, IAM role bindings, and that existing routes and VPN tunnels remain functional. Check audit logs for state-move entries.
notes: This PR addresses multiple incidents where terraform state drift led to partial upgrades for private customers; consult ENG-4123 for rollout cadence. Ops will coordinate a gradual migration per region.
